# Croatia — notes

- 2008–2021: the MUP annual "Statistički pregled" PDFs have a table "Kaznena djela ubojstva po policijskim upravama" (20 police directorates + UKUPNO). I took the reported total (Prijavljena – Ukupno) from each year by column position; for every year the 20 PU figures add up to the UKUPNO figure. A blank cell is printed when there was no case. 2006–2007 PDFs have no such table. Older PDFs (2012, 2016) have damaged characters (ţ, Ď), which I mapped back to ž and đ.
- 2021–2025: the annex workbooks ("PRILOG ... rasprostranjenost po policijskim upravama"; for 2025 the sheet "PRIKAZ KD PO PU" inside the main xlsx) list each Penal Code article per PU. I kept articles 110 (ubojstvo), 111 (teško ubojstvo), 111.a (teško ubojstvo ženske osobe, from 2024), 112–114 and the Glava X total, with completed and attempted rows as published, reported and solved. 2021 is in both sources; the totals agree (30).
- For each PU the annex lists only offences that occurred there, so a missing row means zero.
- Two 2022 labels have no space after "PU" ("PUOSJEČKO-BARANJSKA", "PUŠIBENSKO-KNINSKA"). The parser now handles them; before the fix, their rows had gone to the PU listed before them.
- Police directorates match the 20 counties (županije); the City of Zagreb and Zagreb County together form PU zagrebačka.
- Not done: the attempts tables in the PDFs and the DZS (statistics office) conviction tables. The searching stopped early (search limit reached).
